title: Biorthogonal curvature
exact_claim: There exists a smooth Riemannian metric g on S^2 x T^2 such that (K_g(sigma)+K_g(sigma^perp_g))/2 > 0 for every tangent two-plane sigma at every point. Curvature is the Levi-Civita curvature of g.
